contexts.text: Hello, Mr. Chen, My name is Cindy Clark, head of the human resources department. I want to give you some information about the summer schedule. All departments follow the new schedule starting next week. The summer schedule is in this morning's email. Let me know if there are any questions. Thank you!

Host On our show today, writer Ada Price talks with Neil Crimson about her writing routine. Neil Thank you for being on the show. Could you describe your morning routine? Ada Thanks for the invitation. I usually don't have a morning routine! But, hmm … I get up in the morning, have breakfast, have coffee, then sit down and start writing. Neil What room do you write in? Is it a special room? Ada I don't think it's very special – it's my kitchen! I write at my kitchen table. It's big, and the kitchen is my favorite room in my house. Neil How many words do you write a day? Ada Usually between 1,000 and 2,000. Neil Do you have any habits when you write? Ada I write in a notebook. I don't use a laptop. I have a computer in another room, but I like to use a pen and paper first.

Host Hi, we're back at Radio WMX. We have my friend Adrian with us. Hi, Adrian. Welcome! Adrian Hi. Host Adrian, what are the Bicitekas, and what do they do? Adrian The Bicitekas are a group of people who ride bicycles in Mexico City. We have bicycle tours around the city and teach city cycling to people. We use art like photography, theater, and dance to teach safe cycling. Host How many people ride bicycles in Mexico City? Adrian About 50,000 people ride bicycles in the city every weekend. Host Do you ride your bicycle every day? You are a student, correct? Adrian Yes. I study engineering, and I ride my bike to school every day. My college is really far, so I ride for almost an hour. I always wear a helmet on my head, and gloves. Host What about the tours? Adrian On Wednesdays we offer night tours around the city. There are usually 100 of us on the tour. We go from the north to the south of the city, and we stop a few times to drink water and share stories. We all use night lights and bright clothes. Hope you can join us some time.

Burning Man is a festival in Black Rock City, in the Nevada desert. Many people come to this big party every year. This year about 70,000 people are coming to Nevada. People say it is a great art festival. Its art is famous: and also its theater, music, and bikes – many, many bikes. But for the people that go there every year, the festival is more than that. It's a time for them to meet other people, to share, to talk, to dance, and to give gifts to each other. They say this can help you find the artist in you. They make big fires and live in the desert for a whole week! You only have to be nice to your neighbor, clean up when you leave, and enjoy the festival. In the middle of the festival is a giant man made of wood. At the end of the festival, they set it on fire. This is why it's called "Burning Man. " It's so popular that many TV shows talk about it. This is the thirty-third year of the festival, and all the Burning Man fans are ready to make it very special.

Philippe and I returned from our vacation yesterday. It was my first visit to the Caribbean. Philippe grew up on the island of Martinique. He said, "Claire, I want you to meet my family. " I was excited when we decided to go there. It was beautiful. We stayed near a cool beach called Anse Noire. It's a black beach with blue-green water. One morning, we went on a fishing boat. I was so proud because I caught the biggest fish! Everyone on the island was very friendly. But it wasn't perfect. Philippe teaches French in Bogotá, Columbia, where we live. Street markets are a perfect place to find great prices, save lots of money, and find what we want. But how often do you walk into a store "just to look" and walk out with a lot of things you don't need? Here are some ideas to make sure you don't spend too much when you go shopping. One: Decide a number. Always know how much you want to spend when you shop. And don't spend any more! Two: Make a list. Write down what you need and what you want. Shopping lists really help you remember what is important and what is not. Three: Use cash. Credit cards are dangerous. When you use your card, it's difficult to know how much you're spending. Pay with cash when you can. Four: Save first, spend later. Put some money in the bank for every dollar you spend that day. It doesn't matter if it's only ten cents, it's a good idea to always save every time you spend money. Five: Discuss the price. You can always ask for a better price. You lose nothing and often save more than a few cents. What works for you when you go shopping? Call us at …

Can you do more if you wake up early every morning? My friends do a lot every day. They often get up very
early to clean the house. With a clean house, they go out for a walk with friends. Those friends are always very
positive because they walk a lot and don’t wear headphones because it can be dangerous in traffic. They talk to
each other instead.
They keep their documents and files organized and all in one room. They never leave their books and notes
everywhere around the house. They connect their computer to the outlet, but keep it turned off when
they don’t need it. While they do the housework, the dishes or make the beds, they listen to lively music on

favorite songs.

friends and family.

If you are looking for a unique trip to Europe this year, winter is a good time to go because there are a lot of
spectacular festivals, from the Carnival in Venice to the Snow and Ice Sculpture festival in Belgium. People come
from different countries to enjoy the happy festivals. Which one are you going to next year? Hmm, let’s see…
First is Venice in Italy. It comes alive with people dressed in masks. They always walk along the canals in typical
boats called gondolas. The carnival runs for two weeks every February, in the middle of winter. It is a great
birthday gift for people who like to be near water and who like traditional events.
Then there is a special light festival in Amsterdam in Holland for the whole month of December. There are lights
all around the city and artists come from all over the world and show their work along the canals. Lots of people
visit the city for one or two days so they can see everything.
Don’t miss the Snow and Ice Sculpture festival in Belgium. A different city each year becomes a magical place of
beautiful sculptures. Every year, you can see them every day from November to January.
Last but not least, there is the dynamic Horizon Festival in a small ski resort in Andorra. There are bands playing
every night, and skiing all day and night. It’s a perfect break for a family because there are different activities for
everyone!
So which festival is your choice?

VACATION DANGERS
You might not connect the two, but did you know that going on vacation can be dangerous or even horrible?
If you go on vacation by car, did you know that it can be a dangerous way to travel? People usually have
accidents because they are very tired after driving for hours. This was what happened to San Diego TV news
reporter Michel Grendo. He told us about his experience. When his late-night TV news show ended at midnight,
he took his car and drove to Miami Beach for a long weekend. Unfortunately, he never arrived. His car had a
small accident and he hit a tree. He called an ambulance because he broke his leg and spent his whole vacation
in the hospital! Nobody else was hurt.
If driving is not for you, you could take a bus. In the summer, there are a lot of people who go on vacation at the
same time as you. If it’s hot, people often get angry, and a perfect vacation can soon become horrible. Geologist
Sarna Mendez told us about her experience. She was on a tour bus to see the beautiful White Sands National
Monument in south-central New Mexico. On the first day, the bus broke down in the middle of the desert, miles
from anywhere. They slept on the bus for two terrible nights before a rescue bus arrived. Sarna said it was a bus
trip to forget!

VACATION OR EDUCATION?
A family of three people decided to go on vacation. There’s nothing strange there. Sara and Jorge Miller decided
to take their 15-year-old daughter, Judy, on a one-year long vacation. Judy thought it was amazing. “Wow, no
school,” she said. Her mom took along all her books, and gave her lessons, so Judy had a lot of studying to do.
Judy knew it was no vacation!
They decided to travel 2500 miles across the United States. They followed the I-80 route from San Francisco,
California to Teaneck, New Jersey. On September 1, they drove slowly and looked at their beautiful country.
They visited lots of interesting places and also important monuments. The I-80 route is famous. At Salt Lake City,
they stopped and saw the awesome Leonardo Museum, which is a museum of art, technology, creativity and
science. The family drove through Wyoming, and Sara loved the Natural Corrals Archeological Site in Superior.
It was really amazing because she loves history. They explored a place made of volcanic lava. Then they drove
far north, and Judy ran to the top of Marblehead Lighthouse! It’s 15 meters tall! She won the race with her father
and she felt so proud. Her father was very tired! At the top, they looked at the beautiful water of Lake Erie. On
the other side of the lake was Canada but they didn’t see it because it was far away and the weather wasn’t very
good.
They finally arrived in NJ on July 31. They explored the city for a few days then they drove back home to San
Francisco for 43 hours, non-stop. It was time to start the school vacation at last. Judy was happy because she had
fun out of school, but she missed her classmates. She said, “My friends weren’t with me, but I had my parents
and they’re great too!”

Masala dosa, India
This is a typical food from India and it is great for breakfast or for a snack. To make a masala dosa you need to
make a crepe from rice and egg. Then you fill the crepe with a mixture of potato and onion. You eat the crepes
with lentils and chilies or with coconut sauce and chili. They are amazing!
Som tam, Thailand
This is a famous salad from Thailand. To make the salad you need noodles, onions, tomatoes, peanuts, seafood,
fish sauce and green beans.
You need to first boil the noodles and then mix them with the fresh ingredients. If you like spicy food, then you
can add some chili to make it spicy. It is a great dish and full of flavor.
French toast, Hong Kong
To make this you need two pieces of toast and you put some peanut butter on them both. You put the two
pieces together and then you put egg all over it and you fry it until it is brown. Enjoy!
Fish and chips, UK
The most typical dish from the island. You mix some milk and eggs and then cover a piece of fresh fish with it.
Then fry the fish and eat it with French fries. Add some salt and pepper to add some taste. What are you waiting
for?

Some people move to another country to learn another language, and other people move to travel around the
country and to meet people. If you want to find out about another country, then going to live there is a good
idea.
If you decide to live in another country, first you should think about where you want to go. It’s a good idea to go
somewhere where you have friends or family, so that you have people to get together with. The weather isn’t
something you should think about if you are going to be staying for a few months.
There are a lot of jobs that people can do in different countries and some people only need a cell phone and
a laptop for their work. You should think about if you prefer to work for a company, or if you prefer to work for
yourself before you go. If you work for a company, you may meet more people, but if you work on your own,
then you decide when and where you work.
Moving to another country can be expensive, so it’s a good idea to work before you go to make some extra
money.
Living in another country is always a big move, but it is always exciting.

Augmented reality and advertising
What is AR?
A lot of people love playing videos games on their tablets or laptops and most of these games use augmented
reality or AR. What we see on the screen are digital images and not real things.
Right now, some of the advertising that we see on TV or on online ads use AR. AR often helps to make better
ads. It helps advertisers to sell us more than the object; with AR they can sell us an idea.
How do companies use AR?
Some examples of how AR is used in advertising:
- I n an ad with AR we can see the item we want to buy in the real world. When we see a traditional ad on the TV
or in a magazine we see a photo of the product. If we use AR, we can see all around the product, in front of the
product and behind it.
- A ds that use AR can tell us more about the product they want to sell. They can tell us a story, and we all like
listening to stories. The story can tell us why the product is better than the others.
- C ompanies can use AR to take us on a tour of the store. We watch the ad and we can see inside the store and all
the things to buy. This is more interesting than looking at photos of the store on the webpage.
- Some companies use apps, and with the app we can see the AR.
Why do companies use AR?
AR is often cheaper for companies than traditional ads, and the ads they make for us are more attractive and
more interesting. The future of advertising is changing. And fast.

Let’s talk about selfies
Have you ever counted the number of selfies that you take in a day?
According to the American Psychiatric Association, if you take more than three a day, you may have a problem.
They say that any more than three selfies a day is too much, and that people who take more than six have
a serious problem.
Have you ever taken a selfie in a dangerous place? At the top of a building or a mountain?
If you have, then you are not the only one. But every year there are accidents – and even deaths – from people
who try to take selfies in dangerous places.
Have you ever taken a selfie in Makati City in the Philippines?
According to Time magazine, this the most popular place in the world to take a selfie. People like this selfie
capital because of the skyscrapers and shopping malls.
Who takes most selfies?
Women usually take more selfies than men. The number of selfies we take changes in different cities of the
world. The city where most women take selfies is Moscow. 82% of women in Moscow take selfies in comparison
with 62% in New York.
Do you know how to take the perfect selfie?
According to experts, to take the perfect selfie you have to take the photo from an angle. So don’t take the
photo from in front, take it from the side. Also, your head has to be the right size in the photo. Not too big and
not too small.

But I have sent emails and messages to people, and then five minutes later I think that the email or message was a mistake. You know, the message was too personal, or too angry, or just wrong. Interviewer: OK, and now for an interesting question. Have you ever found love online?

Digital Detox Challenge
Have you ever gone out with friends and left your cell phone at home? Have you ever turned your cell phone off
for 24 hours? If the answers to these two questions are no, then you should try the “digital detox challenge”.
The idea of the digital detox challenge is to use less technology and to spend less time online. Here are some
ideas:
A Use settings
Go to settings and block any emails you don’t want to read, so that you get fewer emails. Now turn off
notifications so you don’t know when you get new emails or messages. Less information is more time away from
your phone.
B Make lists
Make a list of all your devices. Of computers, tablets, cell phones that you use at work, school and home.
Think about which ones you use the most and think about if you need to use all of them. Ask yourself,
“Do I need them all?” If the answer if no, then maybe you don’t need so many devices.
C Download a phone usage app
With this app you can limit the amount of time that you use your phone. You choose the amount of time and
then your cell phone won’t let you use it any more for that day. This really makes you think about how much you
normally use your cell phone.
D Use office hours
You go home after work or after school and you can forget your place of work until 9 a.m. the next day.
Do the same with your phone. If you can, turn it off at the end of your working day. Enjoy the quality time with
your family.
E Turn off your devices at night
It is important for you to sleep, and people sleep better when there are no cell phones or computers in the
bedroom. So, don’t listen to music on headphones, or read on your tablet in the bedroom.

EVOLVE LEVEL 2, Audioscript for Unit 12 Quiz A Rebecca: Have you ever travelled to another country, Jessica? Jessica: Yes, I have. Last year Scott and I got married and we went to Sri Lanka on vacation. Rebecca: Oh, wow! That sounds am azing. What was Sri Lanka like? Jessica: We loved it. Sri Lanka's a beautiful island. Rebecca: How big is it? Jessica: It's about the same size as the state of West Virgini a. We went on a two- week trip around the island and we saw so many things. Rebecca: What did you do? Jessica: Well, we flew to Colombo and we stayed for four days i n Colombo. We visited the stores and the cafés. It was amazing. Rebecca: And what did you like the most? Jessica: It's difficult to say because we did so much. After C olombo we went to Adam's Peak which is a very tall mountain. And we went to a national park to see the animals. We took a lot of buses and a lot of trains around the island. Rebecca: So, you traveled a lot. Were you tired? Jessica: No, because at the end of the vacation we stayed at a beautiful hotel on the beach. I think Scott liked the beach more than the other parts of the vacation! He loves to swim and we just relaxed on the beach and swam every day there. It's a really cool beach because it's between the cliffs and the ocean. Rebecca: It sounds perfect. Did you like the food? Jessica: Yes, we ate a lot of rice and curry. The food is very spicy because they cook with a lot of chilies. It was delicious. Rebecca: It sounds lovely. And what was the weather like? Jessica: Well, we went in July and it was very hot. Some days i t rained because it was the rainy season, but most days it was boiling hot. I had to wear a sunhat all the time. Rebecca: I can imagine.

Community Gardens
People who live in the center of a town or city often don’t have a garden, or if they do, it might be very small.
For people who can’t grow their own fruit and vegetables, a community garden is a great place.
A community garden is a garden which is used by a lot of different people who live near each other.
People work together to grow fruit and vegetables, which are for all the people who use the garden.
Sometimes community gardens are in villages and sometimes they are in cities.
In the USA, American people started making community gardens in the 19th century. They planted fruit and
vegetables in places between buildings and in school gardens. It was the perfect way to use empty land and
they saved a lot of money. During the Second World War Americans grew 40% of their own food!
Community gardens are fun and people enjoy them. People who live in apartments in cities sometimes don’t
know their neighbors. Sometimes old people are lonely because they have nobody to talk to. In a community
garden people meet their neighbors and they talk. Usually people of all ages use the garden, and this can help
children learn about where lettuce, potatoes and tomatoes come from.

EVOLVE LEVEL 2, Audioscript for Unit 12 Quiz B Reporter: Good morning, everyo ne. Today I am visiting a community garden here in Boston. It is a cold, foggy Saturday morning and I am freezing cold! But there are lots of people here this morning at the garden and they look like they are having fun. I'm going to talk to people, but first let me describe to you this amazing garden. Here in Boston there are about 200 community gardens and people tell me that there are probably about 100 more in school gardens. This is one of the 200 and I can see lots and lots of green plants, some fruit trees and some lovely big paintings which the children have painted. The biggest painting is a picture of the skyscraper in Boston and next to it is are mountains and a beautiful waterfall. Now let's talk to one of the neighbors… Excuse me, you look like you are having fun. Tell me, why do you come here? Mary: Hi. Yes, we love it! I am here with my husband Frank and our children. We come here every Saturday. Some days it's foggy like today, other days it's windy and rainy. But we still come! We meet our neighbors and we talk about what we've done during the week. The children play with the chickens or they paint. And we do some gardening and we eat some delicious fruit and vegetables. Look at these strawberries! Reporter: They look delicious . Sorry... What's your name? Mary: Mary. Reporter: Thanks Mary, and enjoy the rest of your morning.

2 weeks in Bali
Day 1-4: You’ll arrive in Ubud and spend two days exploring this beautiful town with its lovely restaurants and
cafés. On day 2 you’ll take a cycling trip into the hills behind Ubud, and if it isn’t cloudy, you can take photos of
the landscape. On day 3 you’ll go walking in the rice terraces. This is an area where people grow rice, and you
can learn about how they grow the rice. A taxi will pick you up and take you a small hotel in the hills.
Day 4-5: You’ll stay in the village in the hills for two days. Here you can meet the local people, eat the typical
food and go walking in the green valleys.
Day 6-7: You’ll travel from the village to the Water Palace. This is a wonderful hotel in the hills which has statues
and fountains in the gardens.
Day 8-9: Lovina is on the coast and here you can go out in a boat to do some fishing. After the fishing you can
relax on the golden beaches.
Day 10-12: Munduk is a village in the mountains and it has waterfalls and lakes. Here you can enjoy the beautiful
landscape.
Day 13- 14. At the end of your vacation in Bali you’ll stay in a small house on Balangan Beach. The beach is
between some cliffs and the ocean, and here you can enjoy the sunny weather, relax and think about the
wonderful things you have seen in Bali.
